method: Independent inspection of actual saved calculation and registered source rows; production renderer comparison
source_outcome: Qualified inbound conversations following earned exposure, named in Month10 toolkit row
before_problem: Organisation response required before counting an otherwise qualified inbound thread
after_observation: Counts an eligible external inbound enquiry or reply with traceable earned exposure and qualification; no organisation-response precondition
response_record_exclusion_scope: Excludes prepared response records only where they do not contain an inbound conversation; does not exclude an unanswered inbound thread
